items.quote: And he said unto Moses, Come up unto the LORD, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship ye afar off.
items.claim: God commanded Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy elders of Israel to ascend to the LORD and worship from a distance
items.place: up unto the LORD; afar off
